name: Mitsuuroko
description: Rows of triangles like dragon scales, each one a crest of three smaller triangles round an empty middle, in red, black and gold.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 75% 50%, 25% 50%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 75% 50%, 25% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @var(--k); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(25% 50%, 50% 100%, 75% 50%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); clip-path: polygon(25% 50%, 50% 100%, 75% 50%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
